pages.text: A villager with no job will take a $(item)Patient Kiln$() as a workstation and become a $(thing)Potter$().$(br2)Potters buy clay, honey and Duskbloom petals; they sell bricks, terracotta and aged goods; and a master Potter parts, at a price, with a $(item)Patience Pottery Sherd$() and the $(item)Patience$() trim template.
